_readme: Single source for the language pages and sitemap.xml. After editing, run: python tools/build_pages.py

apps: id must match the homepage folder https://jbiglion22.github.io/<id>_home/. icon is the inside of a 24x24 line icon drawn for this site (not the official icon). Optional image: "images/name.png".
about: the About page (about-<lang>.html) exists only for the languages listed here. Other languages link to about-en.html.
images: pictures are optional. tools/build_pages.py uses images/<name>.webp|png|jpg only when the file exists (see 이미지요청.md for names). App icons: images/apps/<id>.png.
blog: Korean blog settings. Category ids must equal the app group ids. Posts live in content/posts/ and content/apps/ (see tools/blog.py).
redirects: old language addresses (index-<code>.html) that should forward to index-en.html. Empty since 2026-11-13: the old pages were deleted on request.

published: languages that are on the site. 2026-11-13: Korean only (English hidden for the AdSense review). Add "en" to show the English app list and About page again; their texts stay in "text.en" and "about.en".

en.title:
Small apps
for everyday life
en.intro: Find an app that interests you and learn more on its homepage.
en.footer: Different apps. A place to find them all.

phonebanner.name: Phone LED Board
phonebanner.desc: Turn your phone into a cheering LED board with custom text, colors and motion.

phonespec.name: Phone Spec
phonespec.desc: Search smartphones and compare their sizes and key specifications side by side.

resistorcalculator.name: Resistor Calculator
resistorcalculator.desc: Decode color bands and SMD codes, calculate circuits and find resistor combinations.

arthistorynote.name: Art History Note
arthistorynote.desc: Explore Western art movements, artists and works, with museum information and visit notes.

koreanstudy.name: Korean Study
koreanstudy.desc: Learn Korean from Hangul stroke order to everyday words and real-life conversations.

snapstudy_cbible.name: Catholic Bible Quiz
snapstudy_cbible.desc: Learn the Catholic Bible with daily quizzes, verse references, explanations and a mistakes notebook.

phonecheck.name: PhoneCheck
phonecheck.desc: Check your phone's sensors, screen, sound, battery, camera and network, then compare results over time.

wifideadzone.name: WiFi DeadZone
wifideadzone.desc: Measure Wi-Fi signal in each room and spot dead zones by color on your floor plan, then compare before and after moving your router.

stockcalculator.name: Stock Trade Calculator
stockcalculator.desc: Calculate your average cost after buying more, trade returns, target sell prices and stop-loss prices, with fees and taxes included.

chemnote.name: Chemistry Note
chemnote.desc: The periodic table, ions and formulas, balanced reactions, a step-by-step calculator and 3D molecules in one app.

physicsnote.name: CSAT Physics Formula Note
physicsnote.desc: Review physics concepts and formulas for Korea’s CSAT, with symbols, units and when each formula applies.

mathnote.name: Math Formula Note
mathnote.desc: Korean high school math formulas with symbol meanings, derivations, worked examples and common mistakes.

mathlab.name: Math Lab
mathlab.desc: Move graphs, shapes, probability and sequences yourself and discover the rules of math.

snapstudy_koreanhistory.name: CSAT Korean History
snapstudy_koreanhistory.desc: Memorize Korean history for Korea’s CSAT with key-term cards, quick quizzes, spaced review and past exam analysis.

englishproverbs.name: English Proverbs Dictionary
englishproverbs.desc: Learn English proverbs with Korean meanings, example sentences and pronunciation, then practice with cards and quizzes.

stocksimulation.name: Stock Simulator
stocksimulation.desc: Compare seven investing methods in a virtual market and practice trading without real money.

chromaray.name: Chroma Ray
chromaray.desc: Bend red, green and blue beams with mirrors, mix them and light every crystal across 120 stages.

snowglobe.name: Snow Globe
snowglobe.desc: Watch snow fall in a little winter world. Shake it, decorate your own globe and use focus and rest timers.

groupDesc.learn: Learn Korean and English expressions, Korean history for the CSAT, Western art history and the Catholic Bible with cards, quizzes and notes
groupDesc.science: Math and physics formulas, chemistry calculations, hands-on function and shape experiments, and resistor calculations
groupDesc.phone: Check your phone, compare smartphone specs, show a cheering LED board and find Wi-Fi dead zones at home
groupDesc.money: Work out average cost and returns on stock trades, and compare investing methods in a virtual market
groupDesc.play: A puzzle game about bending and mixing light, and a relaxing snow globe to watch

arthistorynote.desc: 서양 미술사의 사조·작가·작품을 탐색하고, 소장 미술관과 관람노트를 살펴보세요.

phonecheck.name: 폰체크

snowglobe.name: 스노우 볼

ko.title: 사이트 소개
ko.description: J's 앱 소개는 공부, 휴대폰 관리, 계산, 휴식에 쓸 만한 작은 Android 앱을 모아 소개하는 사이트입니다.
ko.lead: J's 앱 소개는 공부할 때, 휴대폰을 살필 때, 무언가를 계산하거나 잠깐 쉬고 싶을 때 쓸 만한 작은 Android 앱을 모아 소개하는 사이트입니다.

p: 앱마다 무엇을 하는 앱인지 짧게 소개하고, 자세한 설명이 있는 각 앱의 홈페이지로 안내합니다. 앱 홈페이지에서 화면과 기능을 살펴본 뒤 Google Play로 이동할 수 있습니다.
소개하는 앱은 대부분 한 가지 일에 집중한 작은 앱입니다. 공부할 때 꺼내 보는 노트, 휴대폰을 점검하는 도구, 계산기, 잠깐 쉬어 가는 게임처럼 쓰임새가 분명한 앱을 모았습니다.
지금 소개하는 앱은 {count}개이며, 쓰임새에 따라 {groups}개 그룹으로 나누었습니다. 소개하는 앱이 늘어나면 그룹도 다시 나눕니다.
앱 설명은 각 앱의 홈페이지와 Google Play 설명을 직접 확인해 씁니다. 앱은 업데이트로 기능이 바뀔 수 있으니, 최신 내용은 각 앱의 홈페이지와 Google Play에서 확인해 주세요.
이 사이트는 한국어와 영어로 볼 수 있지만, 앱마다 지원하는 언어는 다릅니다. 수능 물리 공식 노트, 수능 한국사, 수학공식노트처럼 한국 수능을 준비하는 학생을 위한 앱도 있습니다.
사이트에 쓰인 일러스트와 목록의 아이콘은 분위기를 전하고 앱을 구분하기 위한 그림이며, 실제 앱 화면이 아닙니다.
앱에 대한 문의는 각 앱의 Google Play 페이지에 있는 개발자 연락처를 이용해 주세요.

en.title: About this site
en.description: J’s Apps brings together small Android apps that are handy for studying, looking after your phone, working things out and taking a break.
en.lead: J’s Apps brings together small Android apps that come in handy when you study, look after your phone, need to work something out or just want a short break.

p: It gives a short introduction to each app and points you to that app’s own homepage, where you can see its screens and features and go on to Google Play.
Most of the apps here are small and focused on one job: a study notebook, a tool to check your phone, a calculator or a quick game to take a break.
There are {count} apps here, sorted into {groups} groups by what they are for. The groups change as more apps are added.

sections.h: How the app information is written
p: Each description is written after checking the app’s homepage and its Google Play listing. Apps change with updates, so please see each app’s homepage and Google Play for the latest details.

You can read this site in Korean and English, but each app supports its own set of languages. Some apps, such as the CSAT physics, Korean history and math formula apps, are made for students preparing for Korea’s CSAT.
The illustrations and list icons on this site set the mood and tell the apps apart. They are not actual app screens.
For questions about an app, please use the developer contact on that app’s Google Play page.
